## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`)
- [ ] No AI attribution in commits or this description
- [ ] New user-visible copy added to both `en.json` and `es.json` (or N/A)
- [ ] Responsive at ≥ 360 px and ≥ 1280 px (or N/A)
- [ ] Empty and error states handled (or N/A)
- [ ] Contrast AA; no `dark:` Tailwind variants
- [ ] Images use `<Img>`, not raw `<img>` (or N/A)
- [ ] Auth and role access checked if this touches a secure route (or N/A)
